rule: Use primary exactly when the declaration itself states or defines the source claim. Use supporting for prerequisites, constructions, helper lemmas, instances, or consequences that help formalize the item but do not themselves state it.
source_text: For finite-dimensional semisimple V and a complete pairwise-nonisomorphic finite family of its irreducible types, the assembled evaluation map is an isomorphism; this realizes the source's reduction from direct sums to the irreducible case.
